text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I made way too much mac and cheese 
yesterday! So I just turned it into a 
party at the dorm!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Helios invited her gyaru friends too, and 
the whole place was super lively!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? That look on your face... Did you 
want to join in, by any chance? Right? I 
knew it!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's party together! Let's 
make some noise and have a blast!
